name: Reservations Microservice — ECI Bienestar Total
summary: A reservation, loan and inventory module integrated into a student-built microservices platform.
details: Developed the module with a team of five as part of an architecture built by nearly 30 students.
Implemented the Java and Spring Boot backend with MongoDB and Swagger, deployed on an Azure VM and integrated through an AWS API Gateway.
Automated CI/CD, added JUnit tests and verified 80% coverage with SonarQube.
